content: An open hand can receive gifts, but a tightly clenched fist can hold onto nothing new.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: When fear grips the soul, we ball our fingers into white-knuckled fists, desperately trying to protect our tiny possessions. But a clenched fist is incapable of catching fresh rain, embracing a friend, or receiving divine grace. Open your palms and trust.
practicalInsight: Physically open your hands and let your fingers relax whenever you feel anxious today. Practice receptivity.
reflectionPrompt: What are you desperately gripping with clenched fists that you need to open your hands and surrender?
